reviews.title: Good Value SSD
reviews.comment: Solid SSD. Good value. Fast read/write time. Installation was easy. Quadrupled the storage capacity of my computer instantly. Now it runs faster, crashes less, has no acne, and is attractive to the opposite sex. Okay, not so much those last two, but it did noticeably improve my computer's performance.
reviews.author: THE CONSUMMATE CONSUMER

reviews.title: Good reviews and value.
reviews.comment: Seems like a good deal, but only time will tell if it is durable. Installation was easy - came with a screwdriver which I did not expect. Performance is excellent. I added a heavy-duty heat sink, though reviews suggest it might not be needed.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great value and warranty!
reviews.comment: Great price considering what is happening with all memory products right now.  Perfect addition to my older Lenovo P50 laptop so I can dual boot Windows (traditional SATA SSD), and Linux on this NVMe drive. Faster boot time than my Samsung 860 EVO SSD.
reviews.author: Dusty

reviews.title: A great SSD upgrade
reviews.comment: Great SSD.  Upgraded my Acer laptop from 256 to 512 GB.  Easy.  Perfect fit.  Installation was a snap.  Very fast.  Would recommend
reviews.author: John D.
